executive_assessment.text: Prolonged dry spells and intense heavy rainfall are projected, but rainfall direction and magnitude remain uncertain; mean precipitation was 2,653.4 mm in 1991-2020.
Without adaptation, rural poverty is projected to rise 6.5-6.9 percentage points by 2050 under hot/dry or wet/warm scenarios, versus about 1.5 points in urban areas.

geographic_notes.text: Port Loko; Kambia; Bonthe: Climate change could erase Port Loko's poverty gains by about 12 points by 2050 under either case; Kambia and Bonthe also face wet/warm impacts.

Sierra Leone; Bonthe; Kambia; Western Area Urban; Western Area Rural; Moyamba; Port Loko: 372,000 children (11% of students) faced school-flood exposure; 10% of schools flooded repeatedly, and Bonthe had the highest district exposure and vulnerability.

known_gaps.text: Sierra Leone's direct-climate-FCV material is qualitative NDC risk framing; no measured causal effect or localized conflict-climate dataset was inspected.
The CCDR notes substantial rainfall projection uncertainty; its poverty results are scenario-dependent rather than forecasts of observed outcomes.
